support.title: Spare a few tokens?
support.intro: Open source runs on love, caffeine, and an alarming amount of LLM context. Writing C++ costs the maintainer’s hairline; wrangling AI agents costs cold, hard tokens. If Fluent-Qt saved your UI from a late-night stylesheet meltdown, toss a few coins into the token furnace—every bit keeps the commits flowing.

meta.title: FluentQt (Fluent-Qt) — Fluent UI library for Qt Widgets
meta.description: FluentQt (Fluent-Qt) is a C++17 Fluent UI library for Qt Widgets, with Qt 5/6, optional PySide6 bindings, and WebAssembly. Try the Gallery and setup examples.
a11y.previewGallery: View the Gallery screenshot at full size
a11y.systemHighContrastTheme: System high contrast theme is active
a11y.heroTech: C++17, Qt 5.15 or Qt 6.2 and above, MIT
hero.tagline: A Fluent UI component library for Qt Widgets
hero.detail: Cross-platform controls for input, navigation, tables, and charts, with built-in themes and smooth animations.
hero.pythonCopy: Use the same controls from Python through PySide6
hero.previewHelp: Original 1440 × 900 pixels. Scroll in smaller windows; press Esc to close.
spatial.title: Spatial 3D perspective views
spatial.copy: Place existing QWidget layouts inside SpatialView to add 3D perspective, rotation, and depth. Ordinary 2D apps do not need to enable it.
spatial.widgetsCopy: Keep your layouts, signals, slots, and models while SpatialItem controls 3D position and tilt.
spatial.renderCopy: OpenGL on desktop and WebGL in the browser; static content reuses cached textures.
spatial.optionalCopy: If session activation or view creation fails, the app provides a QWidget layout.
spatial.how: Gallery: Settings → 3D Gallery, then Plugins → Spatial.
spatial.caption: Drag the sliders to adjust the camera and move the pointer to explore depth.
